TECHNICAL SUPPLY CONDITIONS FOR GAUGES 

Part 2 ASSEMBLY AND IDENTIFICATION OF PLAIN PLUG GAUGES 
(SIZE RANGE FROM 1 mm UP TO AND INCLUDING 250 mm ) 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Covers requirements for assembly details and identification of plain plug gauges in the 
size range from 1 up to and including 250 mm. These plain plug gauges may also be used to check 
the minor diameter of internal threads when made according to IS : 421 8 ( Parts 1 to 6 ) 'ISO metric 
screw threads'. 

2. Assembly — Shall be as shown in Fig. 1 to 6.

3. Designation 

3.1 For Nomina/ Size from 1 mm up to and including 65 mm ( Double Ended ) 

3.1 .1 A GO and NO GO plain plug gauge shall be designated by the nominal size of the hole and 
the tolerance class according to IS : 919 ( Part 1)-1963 'Recommendations for limits and fits for 
engirteering : Part 1 General engineeing ( first revision )'. 

Example-. 

A GO and NO GO plain plug gauge to check a hole of nominal size 25 mm and tolerance 
class H8 shall be designated as: 

GO and NO GO Plain Plug Gauge 25 — H8 IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 

3.1 .2 A GO and NO GO plain plug gauge for checking the minor diameter of internal ISO metric 
screw threads shall be designated by the nominal size of the thread and the tolerance class according 
to IS : 4218 ( Part 4 )-1976 'ISO metric screw threads: Part 4 Tolerancing system ( first revision )'. 

Example; 

A GO and NO GO plain plug gauge to check the minor diameter of interna! ISO metric screw 
thread of size M24 and the tolerance class 6H on the minor diameter shall be 
designated as: 

GO and NO GO Plain Plug Gauge M24 — 6H IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 

4 



IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) - 1983 

3.1,3 A GO and NO GO plain plug gauge for tolerances other than those according to 
IS : 919 ( Part 1 )-1963 shall be designated by the nominal size of the hole and its limits. 

Example: 

A GO and NO GO plain plug gauge of nominal size 30 mm with a tolerance ^ 025 shall 
be designated as; 

GO and NO GO Plain Gauge 30-^0 025 IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 



3.2 For Nominal Size above 65 mm up to and including 250 mm ( Single Ended ) 

3.2.1 A GO or NO GO plain plug gauge shall be designated by the nominal size of the hole and 
the tolerance class according to IS : 919 ( Part 1 )-1963. 

Example: 

A GO or NO GO plain plug gauge to check a hole of nominal size 70 mm and tolerance 
class H8 shall be designated as: 

GO Plain Plug Gauge 70 ~ H8 IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 
NO GO Plain Plug Gauge 70 -- H8 IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 

3.2.2 A GO or NO GO plain plug gauge for checking the minor diameter of internal ISO metric 
screw threads shall be designated by the nominal size of the thread and the tolerance class according 
to IS : 4218 ( Part 4 )-1976. 

Example: 

A GO or NO GO plain plug gauge to check the minor diameter of internal ISO metric screw 
thread of size M72 and the tolerance class 6H on the minor diameter shall be 
designated as: 

GO Plain Plug Gauge M72 — 6H IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 

NO GO Plain Plug Gauge M72 - 6H 13 : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 

3.2.3 A GO or NO GO plain plug gauge for tolerances other than those according to 
IS : 919 ( Part 1 )-1963 shall be designated by the nominal size of the hole and its limits 

Example: 

A GO or NO GO plain plug gauge of nominal size 70 mm with a tolerance 4-0 025 shall be 
designated as: 

GO Plain Plug Gauge 70 ! 025 IS : 7018 { Part 2 ) 



NO GO Plain Plug Gauge 70 1 0^025 IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) 





IS : 7018 ( Part 2 ) - 1983 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard on technical supply conditions for different types of gauges, issued in varicus parts, 
has been brought out to avoid mentioning on the standard sheets or drawings of gauges the details 
which are of repetitive nature and which supplement the details already existing. It would be enough 
to refer to this standard wharever the gauges are to comply with these requirements. 

This standard ( Part 2 ) was originally publised in 1980. It has now been revised to bring it in 
line with the latest manufacturing practices in this field in the country. Modifications have been made 
in Fig. 1, 2, 3 and 6 ( showing assembly of gauges ) and the clauses on designation. 

Other parts of this standard are as follows: 

IS : 7018 ( Part 1 )-1983 Technical supply conditions for gauges: Part 1 General {first revision). 

IS : 7018 ( Part 3 )-1983 Technical supply conditions for gauges: Part 3 Assembly and identifica- 
tion of screw plug gauges for ISO metric screw threads (size range from Ml up to and including 
M200 ) ( first revision ).
